photos.title: Longs from above
photos.what: Part of Longs from above (USDA NAIP aerial photo, 2023): a divided highway crossing a county road at the top with a few shops, new streets of houses with ponds at the lower left, and fields and pine woods around them.
photos.caption: Part of Longs from the air: a highway crossroads at the top and new streets beside fields and woods.
photos.alt: Aerial photo of part of Longs, SC: a divided highway and a county road meet at the top, with new streets of houses at the lower left beside fields and pine woods
photos.author: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP
photos.provenance: U.S. government aerial photo: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP), natural color. Exported by Chapter3 from the USGS National Map NAIP image service (exportImage, WGS84) on 2026-11-17; the exact request is in source_request.
photos.license_note: Same source and terms as the NAIP records of /submarkets/garden-city/ (data/2026-11-a/submarkets-garden-city/photos.json): The National Map offers free downloads of public domain NAIP orthoimagery; the USDA FSA policy page says public domain information may be freely distributed or copied, with credit requested.
photos.credit: Photo: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP, public domain, via The National Map (USGS).
photos.changes: Chapter3 Realty cut this view from the NAIP service and cropped it to 4:3
photos.subject_check: Looked at full size by the writer of /submarkets/longs/ on 2026-11-17. Roads, shops, fields, woods and houses; no person, no readable sign, plate or house number at page size.
photos.crop_note: Crops cut from the center of the same 1800 x 1350 export by tools/photos.js crops, for Article.image and the share image.
